clientSeedGenerator.format: <phase-family prefix><32 lowercase hex chars = 128 random bits>

fairnessSpec.derivation: A fresh 8-deck shoe (416 cards) per round. block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i); the stream block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … is read as big-endian 32-bit numbers u. shoe = [0..415] with entry k holding card id k mod 52, shuffled by Fisher–Yates from the top: for k = 0..414: n = 416 − k, draw u, redraw while u ≥ 2^32 − (2^32 mod n), j = k + (u mod n), swap shoe[k] and shoe[j]. Cards are dealt shoe[0], shoe[1], … — George's House Baccarat derivation (handover 21-fair.js).
fairnessSpec.cards: Card id 0..51: suit = floor(id / 13) (0 ♠, 1 ♥, 2 ♦, 3 ♣), rank = id mod 13 (A, 2..10, J, Q, K). Baccarat values: A = 1, 2..9 face, 10/J/Q/K = 0; a hand's total is the sum mod 10.
deal: deal order P1 B1 P2 B2: Player shoe[0], shoe[2]; Banker shoe[1], shoe[3]; then each third card the rules call for takes the next card (the Player's third first)
a two-card total of 8 or 9 either side (a natural) ends the round
else Player draws its third on 0..5, stands on 6..7
Banker then: if Player stood, draws its third on 0..5; else draws by the Player-third-card rule (bt 0..2 always; 3 unless v=8; 4 on 2..7; 5 on 4..7; 6 on 6..7; 7 never)
higher total wins; equal is a tie
rules: Player and Banker get two cards each
a natural ends the round at once
after the rule's draws the higher total wins; equal is a tie
Player and Banker spots push the stake on a tie; a tie spot pays only on a tie
Player Pair / Banker Pair win when that hand's first two cards share a rank — regardless of the Player/Banker outcome
Either Pair wins when either hand's first two cards share a rank; Perfect Pair wins when either hand's first two cards share BOTH rank AND suit, paid once

Player Dragon Bonus wins when Player wins by a natural (rung 'natural') or by a non-natural margin of 9/8/7/6/5/4; a natural tie pushes; any other result loses (incl. a win by 1..3 or a non-natural tie)
Banker Dragon Bonus is the mirror on the Banker side
every payout is rounded down once to the wallet's smallest unit (1e-8), so a spot's return never exceeds 99%
fairnessSpec.return: 99% on every spot, priced on the fresh 8-deck shoe: Player = (99/100 − T)/P, Banker = (99/100 − T)/B, Tie = 99/100 / T, Pair = 99/100 ÷ (31/415), Either Pair = 99/100 ÷ P(either), Perfect Pair = 99/100 ÷ P(either hand's first two cards are the same card). Dragon Bonus pays profit = k·m per rung (m = 1, 30, 10, 6, 4, 2, 1 for natural, 9 … 4), with one exact k per side making P(push) + Σ p_i × (1 + k·m_i) = 99/100. These are George's House Baccarat pays in exact form.
